findings.title: Potential cross-function reentrancy: `basefee_global` and `isCurrentBaseFeeAcceptable`
findings.description: Functions `basefee_global` (has external call) and `isCurrentBaseFeeAcceptable` both modify shared state variables: baseFee. An attacker could re-enter `isCurrentBaseFeeAcceptable` during `basefee_global`'s external call to manipulate shared state.
findings.recommendation: Apply `nonReentrant` to both functions, or ensure the CEI pattern is followed with state updates before external calls in both functions.

findings.description: Division by `contracts` without a preceding zero check. If `contracts` can be zero, this will cause a revert (Solidity 0.8+) or return zero (Solidity <0.8), both of which may be unintended.
findings.recommendation: Add `require(contracts != 0, "Division by zero");` before this operation, or handle the zero case explicitly.
